branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A block-shaped Corrèze cheese about 30 cm long, like Cantal but whiter and milkier. It is a pressed uncooked-paste cheese ripened with artisons, or cheese mites, and is sold under the Pommerol name.

sources.text: Milk, paste, ripening method and origin.
